name: get-me-a-skill
description: Find, evaluate, and choose agent skills for a real job, or identify when to adapt or build one.

interface.shortDescription: Find the right skill for a job
interface.longDescription: Compare existing agent skills against the work you need done, check the evidence and required access, and decide whether to use, combine, adapt, or build.
defaultPrompt: Use Get Me a Skill to find the best skill for my workflow. Ask only the key questions needed to judge fit.
